{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders (population)
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for fake orders — they are not in completed
fake_in_completed = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] == '999999.99']
assert fake_in_completed.shape[0] == 0, "Fake orders found in completed dataset"

# Compute conversion rates by channel
conversion_rates = df_completed.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
email_rate = conversion_rates['email']
search_rate = conversion_rates['paid_search']
difference = email_rate - search_rate

# Print required values
print(f"Conversion rate (email): {email_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {search_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")

# Print final population size
print(f"Final population size: {df_completed.shape[0]} completed orders")"}
